reden: Yes. The audit report’s [Medium] finding “ln accepts zero and negative inputs and returns finite values instead of reverting” is the same issue as the described vulnerability. Both refer to Ln.sol’s ln() function failing to check the sign bit and zero, thereby computing ln(|x|) for negatives and returning a finite value for zero. They share the same code path, root cause (missing validation of non-positive inputs), impact (silent wrong results), and the same fix (add checks to reject zero and negative inputs).
